meta_title: R A Gordon Decorator | Painter Bristol
meta_description: R A Gordon Decorator in Bristol offers professional interior and exterior painting and decorating. Local, reliable, quality finishes. Get your free quote today.
hero_subhead: From feature walls to full room transformations, we deliver flawless finishes on time and within budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Bristol
services_subhead: Whether you need interior refresh or exterior protection, we handle every job with care and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork and feature walls painted to a flawless finish. We protect your furniture and clear up thoroughly before we leave.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant coatings for render, brick, cladding and timber. We prepare surfaces properly to ensure lasting protection and kerb appeal.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Pattern-matched wallpaper hung cleanly with no bubbles or seams showing. We remove old paper and prepare walls to perfection first.

services.title: Cabinet & Furniture Spraying
services.desc: Kitchen doors, fitted wardrobes and built-in units refinished in fresh colours using spray techniques for a professional furniture-maker finish.

services.title: Textured Finishes
services.desc: Artex removal, Venetian plaster, limewash and other specialist finishes applied by hand to create character and depth in your rooms.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Offices, shops, cafés and rental properties painted and decorated on schedule. We minimise disruption and guarantee a professional result.

about_pullquote: I started this because I saw too many cowboys cutting corners. Every job gets my name on it.
about_para_1: R A Gordon Decorator was founded over 20 years ago in Weston-in-Gordano with one simple aim: to transform homes and businesses with the highest standard of painting and decorating. Since then, we've completed over 500 projects across Bristol, from period properties to modern builds, always putting care and craftsmanship first.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, listening to what you want, and delivering exactly that—plus finishes that last. We prepare every surface properly, use quality materials, and leave no mess behind. That's why Bristol homeowners and landlords come back to us again and again.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had R A Gordon redecorate our lounge and hallway. Really pleased with the quality. He was tidy, professional, and finished exactly when he said he would. The paint work looks brilliant and he cleared everything up at the end. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: We'd put off decorating our kitchen for years because we weren't sure who to trust. R A came round, gave us honest advice on colours, and the work was faultless. He's a proper craftsman and the price was fair. Already thinking about the rest of the house now!
reviews.author: Claire L.

reviews.text: Fantastic job on our exterior woodwork. Windows, fascias, soffits—the lot. Weather's been awful but the prep work he did means it'll last. No mess, kept us updated every day, and he organised the skip. Would definitely have him back.
reviews.author: David M.
